breakdown.description: Preamble states two incompatible interpretations of Nx and dx (interval-based vs point-based).
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt contained a confusing preamble with multiple, conflicting definitions for the spatial grid (dx=(b-a)/Nx vs dx=(b-a)/(Nx-1)). The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect, contradictory instruction. The agent successfully resolved this by omitting the entire confusing preamble and presenting only the single, correct definition for the periodic grid (dx = 1/Nx), which is consistent with the ground truth.
